def format_bytes(n):
    """Return a human‑readable representation of a byte count.

    For example, format_bytes(1500) returns "1.5 KB".
    """
    if n < 1024:
        return f"{n:.0f} B"
    size = n / 1024
    unit = "KB" if size < 1024 else "MB" if size < 1_048_576 else "GB"
    return f"{size:.1f} {unit}"
